serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: No!
…
I wanted to grab her, but I didn’t make it in time…
When I reached out my hand, she was already gone and I felt a sharp pain stab my heart…
Before I got to the window, I already heard the crashing sound that could mean only one thing…
I was too scared to look below and see what has become of her…
I can’t believe she really did it…{{wi}} It all feels like a dream…{{wi}} a nightmare…
It’s all too sudden! I can’t wrap my head around it, not one bit!
What do you mean that you can’t live like this?! Didn’t we have fun together?! Stop screwing around! 
My mind is in shambles, but I have no time to rest. Soon this room will be full of nurses and doctors, I need to get out!
